description: This file defines the OrleansLifecycleCanceledException class, a custom exception class used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a lifecycle was canceled, either by request or due to observer error. It includes constructors for message, inner exception, and serialization.

classes.name: OrleansLifecycleCanceledException
classes.description: A sealed custom exception class indicating that a lifecycle was canceled in Orleans runtime, derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: OrleansLifecycleCanceledException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message.

methods.name: OrleansLifecycleCanceledException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message and an inner exception.
